verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single passing statement that the Zoho Books features page documents an audit trail. That is a first-party capability, but nothing shows what it records or how far it reaches. missing for 10: evidence that the audit trail records who changed what and when, evidence that it covers the entire ledger (journals, transactions, settings), detail on retrieving it via the UI or API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger

citations.quote: The features page also documents an audit trail
